findings.claim: The graded final's MCQ part is specified as '40-item, 50-minute' (instructions, line 176; durationMinutes 200 = 150 practical + 50 MCQ, line 171). The captain's standing timing decision for course final MCQs (final, 2026-11-09) allots 2 minutes per question with a 45-question cap: 40 questions therefore require 80 minutes (the recorded precedents are 30/60 and 45/90). At 1.25 min/question, learners sit a graded final at under two-thirds of the mandated time, which directly harms pass rates and contradicts an explicit captain decision.

evidence.section: instructions and durationMinutes of the final blueprint

findings.recommendation: Give the 40-item MCQ 80 minutes (durationMinutes 230, instructions '40-item, 80-minute MCQ'), or reduce the item count so the chosen duration meets 2 minutes per question; re-derive the count from coverage, not from the 50-minute slot.
